answer: Reputation-Gated Work Release. A new identity may only take jobs after its sponsor posts a performance bond; the wharf of task queues admits it solely on that deposit. Each completed job emits a signed signal that raises the bond refund only after a challenge window passes. A vine of cross-checks links every identity to prior task histories, so a clone must fund a fresh bond, wait out the window, and absorb slashing if its work fails verification—costs that exceed the value of one extra identity.
